title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • As a Regional Sales Manager(Federal DoD and/or Civilian), you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer

  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors

  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments

  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks

  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory

  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.

  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services

  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context

  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers

  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts

  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)

  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions

  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Palo Alto Networks is evolving and changing the nature of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.

title: Analista de crédito sênior
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

O Analista Financeiro Sênior na área de Crédito é responsável por realizar análises financeiras aprofundadas para embasar decisões de concessão de crédito, monitorar a saúde financeira da carteira de clientes e propor estratégias para mitigação de riscos. Atua como elo entre a área de negócios e a gestão de riscos, garantindo que as operações de crédito estejam alinhadas com as políticas internas e a estratégia da empresa.

O seu impacto

- Elaboração e execução das estratégias de crédito.

- Elaborar e revisar modelos de score de crédito e políticas de concessão.

- Apoiar a definição de limites de crédito e condições comerciais.

- Manter o adequado controle da exposição de crédito da companhia e reportar à alta liderança quaisquer situações que possam causar impacto – interno ou mercado.

- Monitorar tendências macroeconômicas e setoriais que possam impactar o risco de crédito.

- Gestão de carteira de clientes de alta relevância e risco, emissão de relatórios gerenciais e KPIs de acompanhamento.

- Utilização de ferramentas de gestão de comportamento de crédito – CISP e Serasa.

- Interagir com áreas como Jurídico, Comercial, Riscos e Compliance para garantir a integridade das operações.

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos da Cia.

- Atendimento a auditorias externas e internas.

- Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações para comitês de crédito e alta liderança.

- Avançar nos processos de transformação digital, buscando automatizações e melhorias dos processos.

Quem estamos buscando?

- Formação superior completa em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas Afins.

- Experiência sólida em análise de crédito, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou grandes empresas.

- Conhecimento avançado em Excel e sistemas de gestão financeira (SAP).

- Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e atenção a detalhes.

- Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

- Conhecimento em Power BI/Tableau/ Macro (pode ser um diferencial).

- Espanhol e inglês (podem ser um diferencial).

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Consultor Óptico

title: RELATIONSHIP MANAGER - GERENTE DE RELACIONAMENTO
description:
RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

SAO PAULO, BRAZIL

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Hours: Fulltime, 40 hours per week.

Who we are:

Corpag is a dynamic and international boutique trust and corporate services provider. Our goal is to remain relatively small-scaled, so that we can continue to distinguish ourselves with the personal services we offer to our clients.

Though legislation varies in different countries, Corpag’s ethical code is strict and equal worldwide. We are very happy to help companies and private individuals that are, just like us, entrepreneurial, transparent and earn their money in a sustainable and responsible manner. We are here to optimize their business and be part of their success.

At Corpag we put high emphasis on our ESG policy, by always focusing on people and the environment, in anything we do. This drives us making clear and transparent choices on the industries and clients we want to work with. As we have been a successful and healthy company for over 50 years and as making money is not our main goal, we are in a privileged position of being selective in which type of client we want to work with.

The Relationship Manager will be part of our Brazil team. The Brazil team is a cross-functional team with different backgrounds and diverse skills and perspective, handling challenges for our Brazil client portfolio, working closely together with multiple of our on- and offshore jurisdictions worldwide.

How we see you:

As a Relationship Manager, you will have the opportunity of representing Corpag towards clients and you will play a crucial role within the private and corporate client sector in Brazil. You will be entrusted with maintaining close relationships for the company with existing referral partners (feeders) and clients and ensuring legal good standing for the corporate and private structures of our clients.

Your key tasks and responsibilities are:

· Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals, family offices, corporate clients, and intermediaries, ensuring trust and long-term engagement. Identify and pursue new business opportunities with a focus on existing clients and intermediaries such as lawyers and tax advisors.

· International Structuring: Manage clients’ international structures (trusts, foundations, companies) tailored to their wealth planning, asset protection, and tax optimization needs, while liaising with legal, tax, and fiduciary professionals internally and externally across jurisdictions to implement and manage these international structures effectively.

· Regulatory Compliance & KYC: Ensure full compliance with Brazilian and international regulations, including thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) procedures.

· Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients, including documentation, due diligence, and coordination with internal teams and offshore offices.

· Portfolio Oversight: Monitor and review client portfolios and structures regularly to ensure they remain compliant, efficient, and aligned with client goals.

· Reporting & Documentation: Prepare regular reports, meeting notes, and file reviews for clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability.

· Internal Collaboration: Work closely with global legal, finance and compliance teams to deliver seamless service and resolve client issues.

We offer a varied job in an international boutique style company with an informal culture. Continuous training (tax, legal, AML and soft skills) will be part of the job and opportunities are there to develop further, in Brazil or perhaps in one of Corpag's other international offices in due course under our internal Global Mobility Program.

What you should (ideally) bring:

Ideally, you bring the following experience and interests with you:

  • Legal background (university degree);
  • 3+ years of experience in professional services, preferably in a Trust Company, Private Bank, Multi Family Office or accountancy or law firm;
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and convincingly, verbally and in writing, at all levels of the organization and externally. Within Corpag the main professional language is English. Fluency is Portuguese and English is required.
  • Initiative-driven, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on accurate knowledge sharing, with demonstrated capability to plan and manage resources effectively.

What we value:

He who does not advance, goes backwards. And going backwards is not the way to go at Corpag. We want to go forward. Grow. Spread our wings. Safeguarding our existence while looking ahead. That also entails planning ahead.

At Corpag we attach great value to the competences of our employees. We expect you are familiar with our shared priorities and that you are strongly working together with others. You are a specialist in your area of expertise. A constant focus on integrity is part of everything we do.

What we offer:

Chance to be part of a steadily growing global organization with the highest ESG and fiscal integrity standards in our industry.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;

  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. title: Regional QHSE Compliance and Data Manager
description:

The individual will be part of the regional QHSE team responsible for strengthening the QHSE team by maintaining a skilled and knowledgeable workforce (local team leaders and QHSE staff) with a focus on operational compliance, site investigations, remediation, and property assessments. Key duties include improving team expertise in the QHSE Management System, overseeing the effectiveness of actions implemented as result of risk prevention, incidents investigations and audit programs.

1. Data collection, management and analysis:

  • Collect and compile QHSE data from various sources, such as incident reports, audits, inspections, training records, and environmental monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain robust databases and data systems to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Conduct daily and weekly reviews of QHSE and sustainability data to identify anomalies, discrepancies, or potential errors, ensuring data integrity.
  • Analyze QHSE data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement in safety performance, quality outcomes, environmental compliance, and overall QHSE management.
  • Perform data extraction and mining to identify trends and check for errors.
  • Utilize statistical methods and data visualization tools to interpret data and extract actionable insights.

2. Reporting and communication:

  • Prepare reports and presentations to communicate QHSE data trends and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
  • Provide data-driven insights to improve QHSE and sustainability performance.
  • Collaborate with teams to support improvement initiatives.
  • Present findings to various audiences.

3. System and process improvement:

  • Analyze current and future data system needs to improve data management and reporting.
  • Implement solutions to streamline data processes.
  • Assist in developing and executing QHSE policies and procedures
  • Conduct training on software and create training content for QHSE data requests.
  • Promote company QHSE processes through training and documentation reviews.

4- QHSE control and assurance of our Integrated Management System according to ISO 14001, ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISAGO.

  • Provide feedback to sites through on-site audits, inspections and informal reviews to ensure that site MSM procedures are properly implemented
  • Work with sites to identify risks presented by operations and propose recommendations. Where required, attend or lead process hazard analyses as QHSE subject matter expert

Qualifications and Competencies:

  • More than 5 years of progressive experience in EHS leadership, incident reduction in heavy industries like aviation, manufacturing or construction, etc
  • Strong leadership experience ideally in a multi-cultural, international business environment.

  • Communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to deal with a wide range of situations and personalities, good interpersonal skills
  • Able to work well under pressure and maintain a team spirit and cooperative attitude
  • Able to conduct public speaking, good presentation skills

  • Strong verbal, auditory & written communication skills.
  • Computer literate, with proficient skills in MS-Office suite of programs.

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) II will be the primary liaison between the Investigator sites and Nexcella, responsible for overall site conduct and establishing important relationships with key site personnel. The CRA will perform key job functions in accordance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH GCP), FDA regulations, Nexcella SOPs and work practices while supporting the organizational mission to advance the development of promising oncology therapies and technologies to benefit patients. CRAs are expected to work in a hands-on, highly visible and autonomous role. CRAs must have the ability to be flexible and represent Nexcella in a positive and professional manner while collaborating across all levels with the clinical teams and Sponsors/vendors.

Responsibilities :

• Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits of investigational sites for the Nexcella portfolio of clinical trials.

• Manage the progress of assigned sites by tracking patient recruitment and enrollment, CRF completion and submission, source data verification, data collection, and data query generation and resolution.

• Conduct monitoring activities, including, but not limited to the following:

o Ensuring PI oversight of all trial activities

o Source data review and verification with EDC fields

o Essential documentation review and reconciliation

o Investigational Product (IP) management and accountability

o Lab/kit supply management

• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites and personnel.

• Maintain communication with sites through frequent contact to ensure site compliance, adequate enrollment, and understanding of study requirements.

• Write and submit complete and accurate visit letters and reports of investigational site findings and update applicable CTMS.

• Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.

• Participate in audit preparations and follow-up, as needed.

• Review and address protocol deviations, data quality issues, and identify process improvements for assigned sites.

• Be a collaborative member of the study team: provide insight, updates, and strategies to improve processes.

• Ability to think critically while prioritizing tasks in an efficient manner to meet study deliverables.

• Contribute to CRF development and perform User Access Testing, as requested.

• Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in life science/biomedical/medical science with a proficient knowledge of the clinical/scientific terminology and methods common to the oncology therapeutic setting.

• 2+ years clinical research experience is required.

• 2+ years experience at a CRO or Sponsor required.

• Independent field monitoring experience of oncology clinical trials is required.

• Early phase oncology experience is preferred.

• Proficient knowledge and practical utilization of ICH- GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrate effective presentation skills by clearly explaining complex concepts to a broad range of audiences.

• Ability to independently prioritize tasks with excellent time management skills.

• Highly proficient in computer applications including Microsoft suite of applications, EDC and CTMS applications.

• Fluent in English (written and verbal)

About Nexcella

Nexcella Inc., a wholly-owned Immix Biopharma subsidiary, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company trailblazing cell therapies in AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Líder Técnico de Digital Assets - Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.

Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.

Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs; produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.
  • Desenvolver programas de capacitação: currículo, laboratórios práticos, trilhas de certificação, ativos reutilizáveis (implementações de referência, blueprints Terraform/K8s, templates de contratos).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de co-sell e co-delivery com estratégias de GTM conjuntas e governança clara.

Comunidade Técnica e Evangelismo

  • Representar a Kaleido em meetups, conferências e universidades; liderar workshops, bootcamps e hackathons.
  • Publicar conteúdo técnico (blogs, tutoriais, apps de exemplo, arquiteturas de referência) e manter repositórios OSS demonstrando boas práticas de FireFly/EVM.
  • Formar uma rede de contribuidores e cultivar champions e maintainers locais.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

  • Orientar implementações referência em Kaleido/FireFly (EVM/Besu/Quorum), padrões de privacidade, troca de dados e integrações com sistemas bancários (APIs, eventos, ISO 20022).
  • Definir SLOs/SLIs, IaC (Terraform/Kubernetes), CI/CD, observabilidade e assegurar a transição suave para os times de entrega e sucesso do cliente.

Segurança e Padrões de Custódia

  • Projetar integrações seguras de gestão de chaves e custódia (HSM/KMS, MPC, cofres).
  • Aplicar modelagem de ameaças, auditoria e controles de privacidade em casos de uso regulados.

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 6+ anos em engenharia de software; 3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes; 3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de integração com REST/gRPC, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, mensageria e ISO 20022; familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders (executivos, vendas, produto, reguladores).
  • Fluência em português e inglês avançado; espanhol é um diferencial.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência no desenho de programas de capacitação de parceiros (trilhas de certificação, conteúdos, soluções conjuntas).
  • Conhecimento em Hyperledger Fabric e/ou R3 Corda.
  • Certificações de segurança ou nuvem (CISSP/CCSK, AWS/Azure, CKA/CKAD).
  • Experiência em palestras, publicação de conteúdo técnico ou contribuições ativas em OSS.

Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: HSEQ Coordinator (Health, Safety, Environment, Quality - with Social & Environmental Focus)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced HSEQ Coordinator with a strong background in environmental and social risk management to lead the implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) on a large-scale infrastructure project in Angola . This role will be instrumental in ensuring full compliance with international standards and in fostering a proactive culture of safety, environmental protection, quality, and social performance across all project phases.

This position is based in Angola and will contribute to the promotion of a proactive HSEQ culture aligned with international standards and best practices.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System (IMS) in alignment with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
  • Ensure full compliance with national legislation and international frameworks (IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, and World Bank EHS Guidelines).
  • Oversee the application of environmental and social mitigation measures, including biodiversity management, stakeholder engagement, and grievance mechanisms.
  • Guide and mentor the HSEQ team, ensuring alignment with project goals, clear task allocation, and staff development.
  • Lead incident investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate stakeholder and community engagement in close collaboration with the social performance team.
  • Ensure quality assurance in construction activities through regular inspections, audits, and follow-up on non-conformities.
  • Deliver training and awareness sessions on HSEQ and ESG-related topics across all levels of the project team

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Social Sciences, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in HSEQ roles with strong emphasis on environmental and social compliance, preferably in infrastructure or EPC projects.
  • Proven track record implementing IFC Performance Standards.
  • Strong knowledge of international IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented professional to join our team as Director of Sales. In this key role, you will lead a team of Account Executives, drive growth, and contribute to JoVE’s ongoing success in the Latin America market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the regional sales team to consistently meet & exceed assigned revenue targets in the LATAM region.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the sales team’s activities, driving new business acquisition and expanding existing accounts.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop sales talent to grow and expand the reach of JoVE’s extensive library of STEM video titles.
  • Define, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the sales team, regularly assessing progress and making adjustments to ensure success.
  • Analyze buyer and influencer motivations, competitive dynamics, and the sales cycle to prioritize and refine sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with marketing, customer success, and other teams to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company objectives and goals.
  • Successfully plan and manage renewal projects with existing clients.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience leading sales teams in Higher Education publishing, EdTech, or STEM publishing industries.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales, preferably in the Higher Education sector.
  • Proven track record of success in sales leadership roles.
  • Target-oriented and willing to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Analista Gestão de Pessoas Sr.
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Objetivo do cargo:

Atrair, identificar e selecionar os melhores talentos para atender às demandas operacionais e estratégicas da Diretoria de Logística, atuando de forma alinhada às políticas de Recursos Humanos e às diretrizes organizacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos processos seletivos e contribuindo para a formação de equipes qualificadas e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.

Requisitos do Cargo

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência:

  • Vivência sólida na área de Atração e Seleção.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de entrevista por competência e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included. As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Assessor Comerical | Mercado Financiero
description:

You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.

Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: Analista de Pricing Jr.
description:
Analista de Pricing Jr.

Localização(ões): São Paulo

Arranjo de trabalho: Híbrido

Reporta-se a: Gerente de Pricing

O time que você fará parte

O time de Pricing Vida em Grupo da MetLife responsável por apoiar decisões estratégicas e garantir a sustentabilidade dos produtos de Vida em Grupo. Os principais objetivos da área são a Análise de resultados; Gestão de portfólio; Desenvolvimento e precificação de novas coberturas; Definição de estratégias de preço.

A oportunidade

O Analista de Pricing Jr. é responsável por Cotação de novos negócios dos produtos Habitacional, Educacional e Prestamista. Além de apoiar na precificação de novas coberturas para seguro de vida.

Esse cargo é necessário para nos ajudar nas demandas de novos negócios e oportunidades para crescimento da empresa, permitindo desenvolver habilidades analíticas, comerciais e de relacionamento em um ambiente colaborativo e com propósito.

Essa função está no centro da geração de novos negócios, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da carteira e da receita. O profissional atuará com diferentes perfis de clientes e parceiros, o que exige agilidade, estratégia e capacidade de adaptação.

O sucesso nessa função exige:

Capacidade analítica – para interpretar dados, entender riscos e propor soluções competitivas e sustentáveis.

Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal – para negociar com parceiros, alinhar com áreas internas e garantir fluidez no processo de cotação.

Como responsável por cotações, você colaborará estreitamente com a área de Pricing em um ambiente em que todas as contribuições são respeitadas e todas as perspectivas são ouvidas.

Como você nos ajudará a construir um futuro confiante (principais responsabilidades

  • Cotações de novos negócios;
  • Relacionamento e atendimento ao Comercial;
  • Acompanhamento de Resultado e Portfolio;
  • Precificação de novos produtos e coberturas.

O que você precisa para ter sucesso (qualificações necessárias)

  • Graduação em: Atuária, Administração, Estatísticas, Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Excel Intermediário;
  • Experiência na área de pricing de seguros.
  • Perfil analítico e organizado;
  • Inglês Intermediário)

O que pode te dar uma vantagem (habilidade adicionais)

  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Conhecimento em precificação de seguro de vida;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação.

O que oferecemos?

  • Salário competitivo;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Participação nos lucros;

title: Coordenador de Segurança Patrimonial
description:

  • Liderar equipes terceirizadas, acompanhando indicadores, headcount e controles operacionais.
  • Conduzir processos de seleção, capacitação e treinamentos técnicos, incluindo práticas operacionais e de estande de tiro.

  • Manter relacionamento com autoridades locais e garantir o alinhamento das práticas de segurança às políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar as áreas de RH e contribuir com os resultados estratégicos da área.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Segurança Privada, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Segurança Patrimonial ou áreas afins;

title: Lead Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Mechanical Lead / Installation Supervisor for Lime Kiln Installation in Brazil

We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Lead with a strong background in installation of preheater, kiln, and cooler systems for a major pulp and paper project in Brazil .

The project will take place at an existing plant and is expected to last approximately 1.5 years , starting February 1st, 2026 .

This is a great opportunity for someone with hands-on installation experience in lime kiln, cement, or pulp & paper industries who is ready to take full site responsibility and lead the installation of key mechanical systems in close cooperation with the client and local teams.

About the Role

As the Installation Supervisor , you will lead all on-site mechanical installation activities, ensuring the project is executed safely, efficiently, and according to technical specifications.

You will manage subcontractors, coordinate with engineering and logistics teams, and act as the main technical interface towards the client.

Key tasks include:

  • Planning and coordinating all installation work for preheater, kiln, and cooler systems
  • Supervising contractors and ensuring work quality and alignment with project plans
  • Handling daily progress, reporting, and documentation
  • Conducting inspections, alignment checks, and troubleshooting during installation
  • Leading safety briefings and ensuring compliance with all HSE standards

Your Profile

We are looking for someone who combines technical expertise with leadership skills and enjoys being close to the action on site.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • Several years of experience in heavy mechanical installation – ideally within rotary kiln, lime, or cement systems
  • Strong ability to lead teams, plan work, and communicate clearly with both clients and subcontractors
  • Good understanding of combustion systems , refractory linings , and mechanical tolerances
  • A proactive, safety-oriented mindset and hands-on approach

Languages & Practical Info

  • English is required for technical communication and reporting.
  • Portuguese are a strong advantage due to the location and local workforce.
  • The position is site-based in Brazil for the duration of the project (approx. 1.5 years).

description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager

Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C (exclusive membership services),  B2B (corporate travel management), and  B2B2C (travel concierge services for business partners). Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  bTd travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.

CX Travel Specialist (Night Shift)

We are looking for a  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.

Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.

Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency)

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA accounting process is a plus

Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements

bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.

Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.

Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.

Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  LinkedIn profile or  updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a  self-starter ready to deliver results from  day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: Sales Business Development
description:
About International Digital Partners

International Digital Partners (IDP) is a consulting firm specializing in recruitment and technology services, founded by two industry executives with over 40 years of combined staffing experience. We work with clients in Brazil and abroad , connecting companies with highly qualified talent.

Our Why: We started International Digital Partners because we believe our clients should have easy access to international digital talent and quality international talent should have access to the u.s. companies that need their skills. International Digital Partners serves as this gateway - connecting great companies with exceptional international talent.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to join IDP in Brazil. The role is primarily focused on developing new business opportunities in Brazil, with responsibility for the full sales cycle and for building long-term client relationships. The Sales Representative may occasionally support opportunities with the U.S. market in coordination with the executive team.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in technology, outsourcing/body shop, or recruitment/BPO services.

  • English proficiency is a plus.

Compensation

Why Join IDP?

  • Be part of an ambitious international growth strategy with direct impact in Brazil.

title: Quality Manager
description:
Quality Manager

Location: Manaus, Brazil

As the head of the Laboratory in Brazil, oversee the laboratory’s technical planning and management—with a focus on advancing testing technologies to enhance the laboratory's testing technical capabilities. Take charge of the establishment and management of the laboratory system to ensure the continuous and effective operation of the laboratory quality system. Supervise the calibration of the company’s instruments to guarantee timely, compliant calibration practices.

2.1 System Management

  1. System Development and Maintenance: Based on the company's operational requirements, lead the team to gradually establish and maintain management systems such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO/IEC 27001. Lead the team in conducting management reviews, internal audits, and external audits, and implement targeted improvements.
  2. Continuous Improvement: Promote the development of a quality culture within subsidiaries through various methods, including KCA activities, Lean, and Six Sigma projects, to continuously improve the company's quality culture and performance.

2.2 Supplier Quality Management

  1. Supplier Access and Monitoring: Support the AVL introduction of new suppliers, continuous management and control of the quality performance of existing local suppliers, conduct quality audits and evaluations, improve supplier material quality performance, manage supplier changes, etc.
  2. Material Monitoring: Organize and carry out inspection and problem correction of local and CKD materials, and work closely with the headquarters SQE team to handle quality problems related to CKD materials and follow up on improvements.
  3. Continuous Improvement and Cost Management: Continuously drive improvements in supplier KPI performance, including batch qualification rate and material DPPM performance in the manufacturing line, and collaborate on quality compensation for supplier issues.

2.3 Manufacturing Process Quality Management

  1. Process Control Standards: Work closely with headquarters to establish, improve, and implement subsidiary process control standards, including yield rate monitoring, control plans, and key control parameter monitoring.
  2. Process Monitoring and Management: Implement process monitoring including first-article control, dummy tests for key processes, IPQC inspections, and process-specific inspections.
  3. Manufacturing Worker Training and Qualification: Provide job qualification and periodic training for manufacturing workers, including new employees and existing employees.
  4. Process Problem Management: Monitor production defective product data, lead the processing, analysis and improvement tracking of process batch problems, and lead the process shipment risk assessment.

2.4 Customer Quality Management

  1. Outgoing Quality Assurance: Formulate product outgoing inspection standards, conduct outgoing quality inspections at different manufacturing stages, analyze, process and improve defects found in OQA sampling checks.
  2. Customer Audit: Lead various types of audits conducted by customers or third-party certification bodies on the factory, including audits for manufacturing processes and audits for system management, to ensure that the audits are passed.
  3. Customer Acceptance: Lead the factory customer acceptance of shipped products, handle acceptance problems, and ensure that the acceptance is passed on the first attempt.
  4. Customer Issue Handling: Respond to customer feedback or complaints promptly, lead the investigation and improvement of issues related to customer feedback or complaints, and output relevant analysis and improvement reports (8D reports or FA reports) as required, to minimize the severity and impact of customer complaints, continuously improve and enhance customer satisfaction.
  5. RMA Processing: Timely collect customer-end quality performance data, promptly lead the improvement of high-frequency and serious problems, analyze and handle customer RMA products, and promptly meet customer RMA processing requirements.
  6. External Expenses and Costs: Perform timely statistics and analysis of external quality problem costs, provide early warning of large expenses, and reduce external loss costs.

2.5 Lab Management

  1. ISO/IEC 17025 Certification: Closely cooperate with the headquarters to complete the ISO/IEC 17025 certification and maintenance to support the local delivery of products, independently manage the local laboratory system and maintenance, and ensure the first inspection qualification.
  2. Measuring Instrument Calibration Management: Organize the team to complete the internal and external calibration of the factory's measuring instruments within the cycle, track the calibration process and handle exceptions.
  3. Daily Management: Be responsible for the daily management of the laboratory, including the continuous construction of testing capabilities, coordination of third-party testing resources, recruitment and assessment of personnel, and safety management, to ensure the efficient operation of the testing center.

【Qualifications】

  1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above, major in engineering, quality management or other related fields.
  2. Industry Experience:
  • Have 8 years or more of manufacturing quality management experience in the electronics industry, with at least 3 years of experience in quality team management and laboratory management.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 17025 systems.
  1. Language Skills: Fluent in English and Portuguese. Chinese is preferred.
  2. Professional Skills:
  • Proficiency in applying quality tools and methods, such as FMEA, PPAP, MSA, CPK, SPC, and Minitab.
  • Qualification as an internal auditor for ISO9001/17025 and other systems, and familiarity with Brazilian INMETRO and other certification regulations.
  1. Others:
  • Leadership: Effective team building, cross-departmental collaboration, the ability to drive problem resolution and improvement both internally and externally, and the continuous development of a quality culture.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated systematic thinking, data-driven decision-making, and efficient achievement of quality goals.

Na Cinemark promovemos a diversidade. Aqui todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A Gerência de Planning tem como missão garantir que as metas existentes sejam desafiadoras e factíveis e que as decisões da Diretoria Executiva local e de Dallas sejam tomadas com base em informações corretas, precisas, confiáveis, com alto nível de previsibilidade e geradas de forma rápida e contínua.

  • Responsável pelas atividades de FP&A com destaque para a construção e gestão do Budget (G&A e P&L), análises de real vs orçado, preparação de relatórios executivos, elaboração das apresentações do CEO/CFO, análises de Capex e projeções financeiras.
  • Responsável pela gestão de Pricing em todos os cinemas da Rede. (Preços por dia da semana e horário, Preços por Tecnologia 2d, 3d, XD, VIP, DBOX, Preços por tipo de Ticket: full price, half price, Vivo, Bradesco, Promoções por cinema e dia da semana, análises de preço por Micromercado & Canibalização). Análises de elasticidade e avaliação post morten destas ações.
  • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e gestão do Market Share , além de análise de investimentos e Valuation em projetos de M&A.
  • Acompanhamento do Real vs Orçado, Construção de Forecast, Gestão do Orçamento de Despesas e Capex, tendo interface direta com departamentos da área corporativa no Brasil e nos EUA.
  • Responsável pela gestão da agenda macro estratégica da empresa (reuniões de Mkt Share e de Resultado, reuniões do Presidente com a Diretoria Executiva, gerando informações para decisões de aumentos de preço, inclusão/retirada de promoções, corte de custos, análises de investimento, aprovações e cancelamentos de projetos.
  • Análise de mercado, avaliando estratégia dos competidores, análise de rentabilidade do Cinemas bem como impacto de inflação nos custos operacionais.
  • Gestão da ferramenta Scorecard que é utilizado para pagamento de bônus de todos os executivos (todos os KPIs são validados por Planning na abertura do Scorecard, bem como o realizado passa pela auditoria de Planning).
  • Avaliação dos investimentos em conjunto com a Diretoria de Expansão ( take overs, new Builds, new Screen Addition, Screen conversion to VIP Concept são exemplos de iniciativas de investimento ao qual cabe ao time de Planning o estudo de viabilidade econômica e alinhamento com a Matriz nos EUA, gestão do ROI da Proforma/Estudo Viabilidade vs Real e suporte ao time de Dallas na avaliação de Impairment do Investimento).
  • Estudos AdHoc de qualquer natureza quando solicitados por Dallas e/ou Presidente/Diretor Financeiro Local.
  • Análise individual dos cinemas com objetivo de melhoria do ROI dos cinemas.
  • Gestão do time de Planejamento Financeiro.

Requisitos e qualificações

· Expertise/ Know-how em FP&A com passagem por indústrias consolidadas;

· Formação Acadêmica em Economia, Administração ou Engenharias

· Forte conhecimento em Contabilidade Societária (BRGAAP e USGAAP) e gerencial (Fluxo de Caixa Direto e Indireto, Margem de contribuição, Estatística, Análises mercadológicas), Conhecimento em Hyperion e Excel Avançado, forte expertise com apresentações para alta Administração (Local e Dallas).

· Inglês fluente para interface com Dallas; Espanhol desejável para interface com HQ LATAM

Com mais de US$ 70 milhões em capital de risco , crescemos de forma consistente nos últimos seis anos e já completamos mais de 150 milhões de pedidos através da nossa plataforma.

Hoje, atendemos mais de 100 clientes e contamos com milhares de freelancers em nossa rede.

Você é um profissional de vendas orientado a resultados , com mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada superando metas de forma consistente. Possui um perfil analítico, com forte disciplina na medição e acompanhamento de indicadores para embasar decisões estratégicas.

  • Analisar mercado e concorrência: realizar análises contínuas de mercado e concorrentes para antecipar tendências e ajustar táticas comerciais.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração: alinhar-se de perto com as áreas de Marketing, Produto e Operações para garantir a satisfação do cliente e entregar soluções integradas e personalizadas.

title: Técnico de manutenção | Caminhões Pesados
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Realizar manutenção corretiva e preventiva em equipamentos, desmontando, limpando, substituindo componentes e indicando soluções técnicas para evitar desgaste ou quebras frequentes, tanto na oficina como nas instalações do cliente;
  • Aferir ferramentas por simulações de operação, realizar testes de capacitação de torque, ajustando conforme necessário;
  • Instalar máquinas e equipamentos nos clientes, verificando conexões, testando componentes e acompanhando operação na produção;
  • Apoiar no planejamento de manutenção quando necessário;
  • Efetuar adaptações de acessórios e regulagem dos equipamentos instalados;
  • Prestar suporte técnico na especificação de peças de reposição e alterações técnicas de manuseio e funcionamento;
  • Realizar treinamentos complexos dos equipamentos SANY;
  • Analisar equipamentos para manutenção, identificando necessidades de reposição de peças e estimando vida útil, repassando dados para orçamento ao cliente;
